title: CORS reflects any origin with credentials
notes:
CORS misconfiguration on GET /api/profile: the server reflects any Origin and sends Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
From https://evil.test a script can read the logged-in user's profile (name, phone, address) when the victim visits the page.

evidence.name: cors-response.txt
evidence.text:
GET /api/profile HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.acme.test
Origin: https://evil.test

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://evil.test
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
